title: Review the existing five-domain passive PHP inventory
instructions: Read AGENTS.md, advisory.json, setup-status.json, research/passive-batch-001.json, and the observation schema in the attached repository. Collaborate across researcher, maintainer, and reviewer positions. Verify the existing five candidate entries against the named technology profiling source and review PHP2Shell claims against primary advisories. Contact only the profiling services and advisory sources; do not send requests to any candidate hostname. Do not enumerate new domains, perform port scans, run CVE probes or exploit payloads, or contact owners. Keep both CVE statuses unknown unless reliable owner runtime or vendor package evidence actually supports a different status. No such evidence is currently present. Do not change scope.json or expand the batch. Write a concise review in research/passive-batch-001-review.json with source URLs, limitations, and any corrections. Review the diff, commit and push appropriate passive-research changes to the attached repository, and report the commit hash. Never include credentials, cookies, raw response bodies, or raw logs. Finish after this single review; do not start another mission or leave a scanner or scheduled process running.
